name: Nordkraft Headphones Pro
description: The Nordkraft Headphones Pro. A dependable audio pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Headphones, Cable clip, Carry pouch, USB-C charging cable, Spare pads

reviews.author: Aditi K.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. It does the one job it advertises and does it well. Second Nordkraft product I own and both have lasted. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Karthik M.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Packaging was tidy and nothing was missing. No regrets.

reviews.author: Lakshmi M.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Second Nordkraft product I own and both have lasted. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Lakshmi D.
reviews.title: Does the job
reviews.body: It is fine, but I expected slightly more. Slightly heavier in hand than the listing suggests. Packaging was fine, the manual less so. Fine for casual use.
